rewrites.comment: Cho /api/* di thang toi ham may chu. Luat nay phai dung TRUOC luat bat-tat-ca ben duoi, vi Vercel xet theo thu tu va dung o luat khop dau tien.

App la dang mot-trang: khong co file that cho /orders/<id>, /tasks/<id>, /company-feed/<id>. Khi bam vao thong bao day luc app dang DONG, he dieu hanh mo thang dia chi do -> may chu khong tim thay file -> 404 trang xoa. Luat nay tra ve index.html, roi app tu doc dia chi va mo dung don (src/lib/deepLink.js). Vercel kiem tra file that TRUOC nen assets/*.js, sw.js, version.json van duoc phuc vu binh thuong.
